# University of Portsmouth Research Portal

> > A comprehensive repository of research activities, publications, and academic events from the University of Portsmouth, showcasing multidisciplinary scholarship across sciences, humanities, and social sciences.

The Research Portal documents the scholarly contributions of University of Portsmouth faculty and researchers, including conference presentations, advisory roles, external examining activities, and collaborative research initiatives. Key research centers include the Centre for European & International Studies Research, Centre for Studies in Literature, Centre for Enzyme Innovation, and Faculty of Science & Health, with notable work in sports science, geology, literature, and international development.

## Key Topics

- University of Portsmouth
- Centre for European & International Studies Research
- Centre for Studies in Literature
- Centre for Enzyme Innovation
- Faculty of Science & Health
- Conference participation and presentations
- Sports science and biomechanics
- International Geological Correlation Programme
- European studies
- Caribbean development
- Swimming research
- Literature and cultural studies
- Research culture and impact
- External examining and advisory roles
- Academic collaboration across UK and Europe

## Research Activities & Events

- [Culture and Knowledge Economies: The Future of Caribbean Development?](https://researchportal.port.ac.uk/en/activities/culture-and-knowledge-economies-the-future-of-caribbean-developme): B. Garner's plenary on Caribbean development at Caribbean Studies Assoc.
- [Breaking Boundaries Conference](https://researchportal.port.ac.uk/en/activities/breaking-boundaries-conference): Erik Mathisen on citizenship & loyalty in American Republic at London conf.
- [Religion and Animal Ethics](https://researchportal.port.ac.uk/en/activities/religion-and-animal-ethics): Kay Peggs conference presentation on religion & animal ethics in Oxford
- [Association for Teacher Education in Europe Conference 2016](https://researchportal.port.ac.uk/en/activities/association-for-teacher-education-in-europe-conference-2016): Charlotte Meierdirk at ATEE 2016 conference in Eindhoven, Netherlands
- [The Development Studies Association Annual Conference 2012](https://researchportal.port.ac.uk/en/activities/the-development-studies-association-annual-conference-2012-4): Ivica Petrikova at Development Studies Association 2012 in London
- [BAL Research Conference 2020](https://researchportal.port.ac.uk/en/activities/bal-research-conference-2020): Chianu Dibia at BAL Research Conference 2020 in Portsmouth

## Sports Science & Biomechanics

- [Biomechanics and Rehab in Strength & Conditioning](https://researchportal.port.ac.uk/en/activities/biomechanics-and-rehab-in-strength-amp-conditioning): Jack Hughes workshop on biomechanics & rehab in strength conditioning
- [Oral presentation to European College of Sports Sciences conference delegates in Dublin](https://researchportal.port.ac.uk/en/activities/oral-presentation-to-european-college-of-sports-sciences-conferen): Mitch Lomax presents MetaSwim reliability study at ECSS in Dublin
- [External examiner at the University of Edinburgh](https://researchportal.port.ac.uk/en/activities/external-examiner-at-the-university-of-edinburgh): Mitch Lomax as external MSc examiner on hypoxia & elite swimming

## Geological Sciences

- [International Geological Correlation Programme](https://researchportal.port.ac.uk/en/activities/international-geological-correlation-programme): Rob Strachan at 1988 IGCP conference on Cadomian orogeny
- [International Geological Correlation Programme (IGCP) 497 Meeting](https://researchportal.port.ac.uk/en/activities/international-geological-correlation-programme-igcp-497-meeting): Rob Strachan organizes IGCP 497 geology meeting in 2005

## Literature & Cultural Studies

- [Jane Austen: Sex, zombies and vampires](https://researchportal.port.ac.uk/en/activities/jane-austen-sex-zombies-and-vampires): Benjamin Dew's Year 12 presentation on Jane Austen literary adaptations
- [Dickens's Women](https://researchportal.port.ac.uk/en/activities/dickenss-women): Patricia Pulham workshop with Miriam Margolyes on Dickens's women

## Advisory & Governance Roles

- [REF2028 UoA Coordinator and Steering Committee member (Event)](https://researchportal.port.ac.uk/en/activities/ref2028-uoa-coordinator-and-steering-committee-member-event): Sam Robson's REF2028 UoA coordinator & steering committee role
- [Hampshire Constabulary Advisor](https://researchportal.port.ac.uk/en/activities/hampshire-constabulary-advisor): Claudia Cox as independent advisor on race & inclusion for Hampshire Police
- [Arts & Humanities Research Council (External organisation)](https://researchportal.port.ac.uk/en/activities/arts-amp-humanities-research-council-external-organisation-11): Joan Farrer's AHRC board membership role at UK research council
- [Enhancing Research Culture: Impact Culture](https://researchportal.port.ac.uk/en/activities/enhancing-research-culture-impact-culture): Sam Robson workshop on enhancing research & impact culture

- [Talk to Albert Einstein Institute members](https://researchportal.port.ac.uk/en/activities/talk-to-albert-einstein-institute-members): Stephen Webb's invited talk on Fermi paradox at Max Planck Institute
